population.kidComparison: About 51.7 million people live in Sudan—roughly the population of a major world region.

geography.climate: Subtropical to warm temperate climate, ranging from sunny coasts to dry inland areas.
geography.terrain: Mix of coastal plains and inland terrain.

anthem.title: National Anthem of Sudan
anthem.summary: The official patriotic anthem played at national ceremonies in Sudan.

exploration.didYouKnow: Sudan is located in Northern Africa and its capital city is Khartoum.
